title: Fix mobile receipt upload triggering camera
body: ## Summary - remove `capture="environment"` from receipt upload inputs so mobile users can pick files/gallery instead of forced camera launch - harden the self-hosted OCR service with multi-pass image preprocessing and automatic best-result selection - add image normalization helpers (resize, deskew, CLAHE, denoise, adaptive threshold, sharpen) - add OCR quality scoring (confidence + text density + line count) and fast-path acceptance for already good results - add OpenCV dependency for the OCR service preprocessing pipeline ## Why Mobile upload behavior was forcing camera for file selection. Also, OCR quality on challenging receipt photos needed improvement while staying strictly self-hosted. ## Validation - code-level check: no remaining `capture="environment"` in app code - committed and pushed branch changes - next step in this iteration: deploy and run smoke checks against production OCR endpoint
